results.title: Gigi & Nate
results.overview: A young man with a bright future suffers a near-fatal accident and recreates his new life with the help of an unlikely animal friend.

results.title: Peacock
results.overview: A minor train accident in rural Nebraska gradually unveils a mystery involving the town's reclusive bank clerk.

results.title: Glitter
results.overview: A young woman is catapulted into pop stardom, with her already-famous DJ boyfriend calling the shots.

results.title: A Farewell to Ozark
results.overview: Jason Bateman, Laura Linney and other cast members open up about the show's characters and creators, plus what they'll miss most.

results.title: Beethoven's Treasure Tail
results.overview: After everyone's favorite St. Bernard gets fired from a movie, Beethoven begins the long journey home with his trainer, Eddie. On their way, they become stranded in a small coastal town where the beloved canine befriends a young boy who is searching for buried treasure.

results.title: Some Velvet Morning
results.overview: Fred arrives at the doorstep of his beautiful young mistress Velvet after four years apart, claiming to have finally left his wife. But when she rejects his attempts to rekindle their romance, his persistence evolves into obsession — and a dark history between the former lovers comes into focus.

results.title: Just Before I Go
results.overview: Ted Morgan has been treading water for most of his life. After his wife leaves him, Ted realizes he has nothing left to live for.  Summoning the courage for one last act, Ted decides to go home and face the people he feels are responsible for creating the shell of a person he has become.  But life is tricky.  The more determined Ted is to confront his demons, to get closure, and to withdraw from his family, the more Ted is yanked into the chaos of their lives. So, when Ted Morgan decides to kill himself, he finds a reason to live.

results.title: Lowriders
results.overview: A young street artist in East Los Angeles is caught between his father's obsession with lowrider car culture, his ex-felon brother and his need for self-expression.

results.title: Grandma
results.overview: Self-described misanthrope Elle Reid has her protective bubble burst when her 18-year-old granddaughter, Sage, shows up needing help. The two of them go on a day-long journey that causes Elle to come to terms with her past and Sage to confront her future.

results.title: Buster's Mal Heart
results.overview: An eccentric mountain man on the run from the local sheriff recalls the mysterious events that brought him to his present fugitive state.

results.title: Cheaters
results.overview: In the fall of 1994, a teacher at Chicago's run-down Steinmetz High conspires with the school's academic decathlon team to cheat on an academic competition.

results.title: Best of the Best 3: No Turning Back
results.original_title: Best of the Best 3: No Turning Back
results.overview: A martial arts instructor comes to the defense of a schoolteacher who has taken a stand against a local white supremacist organization.

results.title: Committed
results.overview: After her husband, Carl, suddenly leaves, Joline travels from New York to Texas to track him down. Although Joline tries to remain upbeat, she is discouraged when she discovers that Carl already has a new girlfriend, the lovely Carmen. Familiarizing herself with Carl's new home and friends, Joline gets company in the form of her brother, Jay. Will Joline win Carl back, or are there other romantic possibilities on her horizon?

results.title: High Heels and Low Lifes
results.overview: Two friends are drawn into a seedy underworld of extortion and violence when they try to blackmail a gang of bank robbers.

results.title: Cedar Rapids
results.overview: A naive Midwesterner insurance salesman travels to a big-city convention in an effort to save the jobs of his co-workers.

results.title: Untouchable
results.overview: The inside story of the rise and fall of Harvey Weinstein reveals how, over decades, he acquired and protected his power even when scandal threatened to engulf him. Former colleagues and accusers detail the method and consequences of his alleged abuse, hoping for justice and also to inspire change.

results.title: Scooby-Doo! Ghastly Goals
results.overview: While on vacation in Brazil, Scooby-Doo and the gang encounter a mythical beast at a game of soccer.

results.title: Wer
results.overview: A defense attorney begins to suspect that her client, who is charged with the murders of a vacationing family, might be more than meets the eye.

results.title: Staten Island Summer
results.overview: Pals Danny and Frank spend the summer after high school working as lifeguards while figuring out their future.

results.title: The Trench
results.overview: The Trench tells the story of a group of young British soldiers on the eve of the Battle of the Somme in the summer of 1916, the worst defeat in British military history. Against this ill-fated backdrop, the movie depicts the soldiers' experience as a mixture of boredom, fear, panic, and restlessness, confined to a trench on the front lines.
